notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you in Karate Survivor: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Improvised Combat:[/b] Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
[*][b] Environmental Warfare: [/b]Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
[*] [b]Dynamic Combos: [/b]Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
[*] [b]Progression and Mastery: [/b]Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
[*] [b]Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: [/b]Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 
[/list]
Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Technotopia is Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Technotopia, a game developed by Yustas and published by Alawar, is now available on Windows and macOS![/b] The city of the future awaits, and it’s your time to take control. 

As the AI Iris, you are tasked with creating the perfect city in a world fractured by social and economic unrest. The metropolis teeters on the edge of chaos, and the balance between competing factions is fragile. Every decision you make will shape the fate of Technotopia – will you build a utopia, or let the city descend into turmoil? 

[previewyoutube=8ZPQsLAHWfg;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Technotopia: 

[list]
[*] 4 Faction-Driven Questlines: Capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and common citizens all want control of the city. Navigate their conflicting agendas and choose your allies wisely – each storyline will alter the city’s future. 
[*] 100+ Unique Buildings: Construct skyscrapers, parks, residential zones, and industrial hubs. Every building you place will influence the balance of power, helping or hindering different factions. Strategically combine city blocks to maximize efficiency and unlock special bonuses. 
[*] 50+ Dynamic Events: From everyday mishaps to faction conflicts, every event in Technotopia is shaped by your choices, with consequences that ripple across the city. 
[*] Factions' Influence: Every decision shifts the delicate balance between the city’s ruling groups. Will you appease the elites, or side with the people? 
[*] City News & Criminal Activity: As crime rises, new challenges emerge, forcing you to make tough decisions. Stay informed through real-time news reports that reflect the impact of your actions on the city's order. 
[/list]
Get the game with a [b]10% launch[/b] discount and share your feedback on Technotopia – we’re excited to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Necroking is now available!
notes.content:

notes.title: Major Update 1.5
notes.content:
We have worked hard and are excited to introduce this major update to you. It includes many changes and fixes based on player feedback, as well as a small part of new content. Please ensure you have the latest version (1.5) of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710780/530be3ace6791e571e52c167c28c30271412d31f.png[/img]

[b]List of changes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Added a dungeon with new content, including a new type of mushroom enemy and a resource building. The entrance to the dungeon is located near the altar of magic. 
[*] Added a message about saving progress when exiting to the main menu. 
[*] Added highlighting for the currently used save slot. 
[*] Changed the controller binding system. Players can now use PS, Xbox, and Switch controllers. 
[*] Changed the functionality of the left stick on controllers to register inputs in all directions for smoother character movement. 
[*] Changed the altar of healing functionality. It no longer consumes life essence if the character's health is full. 
[*] Fixed many visual bugs, including enemies getting stuck in walls, the king's hands disappearing, and ground textures disappearing while moving. 
[*] Fixed the counter for the achievement “Kill 30 enemies using X weapon”, where X denotes the type of weapon. 
[*] Fixed SFX issues and added new sounds. 
[*] Various other fixes. 
[/list]
Buy the game now to avoid missing the 33% discount on Kingsgrave in celebration of the new update: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644360/Kingsgrave/ 

Thank you for your support and help in making Kingsgrave better!

notes.title: News regarding the update
notes.content:
Dear players,

We regret to inform you that the update we had promised to release today for Kingsgrave has been delayed. The issues we were trying to fix have turned out to be more serious than we initially anticipated. We believe that releasing an unprepared version now would only lead to further complications and potentially introduce new issues.

Therefore, we have made the decision to delay the update until tomorrow when we are confident that it works correctly and does not add any new problems. Our team is working diligently to address these issues and ensure that the update is stable.

We apologize for any inconvenience this delay may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding. We will keep you updated on our progress.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Kingsgrave is now available!

Hail, noble royals! Let trumpets sound and banners fly for the long-awaited moment – Kingsgrave has arrived on Windows and MacOS! 

In the wake of a devastating disease that has befallen the lands, plunging them into darkness and despair, the time has come for the king to rise from slumber and reclaim what rightfully belongs to his people. The lands languish under the weight of sickness and sorrow, with once-thriving settlements now nothing but shadows. [previewyoutube=OmVzYrIJYAE;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] Gather resources, reconstruct buildings, and restore subjects' houses, while defeating enemies to revive the realm and restore its prosperity. Your strength grows with each restoration, solidifying your reign as a wise monarch.

[*] Traverse forests, deserts, volcanoes, and catacombs in an interconnected world. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and navigate perilous terrain on a journey worthy of a true king.

The fate of the realm hangs in the balance, awaiting the guiding hand of a true sovereign. Will you answer the call and lead your people to triumph, or will you allow darkness to consume your lands? The choice, dear ruler, is yours to make. Let the legacy of Kingsgrave begin!

notes.title: Upcoming Plans
notes.content:
Greetings, Royals! 

The playtest for Kingsgrave is over, and we’re ready to announce some changes based on your feedback. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44710780/a313679df6d43fe3b87f073011a45a0ae877312f.jpg[/img]

Firstly, we want to thank you for the support, activity, and patience you showed during the playtest, as well as the ideas you shared with us. We have carefully reviewed everything and made a plan for the upcoming changes to the next build. Here are some of the them we’ve been starting to implement into Kingsgrave: 
[list]
[*] Repositioning puzzle elements. All crucial riddles essential for the main storyline will now be placed in the surrounding territories and won’t be scattered across the entire map. 
[*] Making complex riddles optional, eliminating frustration and allowing a smoother progression through the plot. 
[*] Introducing more dialogues for NPCs (similar to the Cartographer) who will impart pieces of the story, immersing the player in the world’s lore. 
[*] Providing more detailed descriptions for weaponry and buildings so that players can make informed decisions on resource spending and understand the bonuses they will receive. 
[*] Highlighting interaction objects and collectibles will be available as a basic skill. 
[*] Rebalancing the amount of resources at the beginning of the game to prevent player frustration if they miss some. 
[*] Adding a visual effect to the location torch when the area is cleared. 
[*] Implementing a visual transformation of lands cleared from darkness. 
[*] Increasing the hitboxes for the weapon. 
[*] Widening the bridges to prevent characters from getting stuck. 
[*] Reworking sound and visual effects for a more immersive experience. 
[*] Changing the position of some puzzles. 
[*] Refining the main menu and death/pause windows. 
[*] Enhancing the options menu and other UI elements. 
[/list]
You will soon be able to try out all these changes and more in the demo, which will be a part of the Steam Next Fest next month. Thank you for your participation and support! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644360/Kingsgrave
